title: My Brother-In-Law Forged A Dissolution, Sold My $650K Clinic, Sent $4,300. So I Voided The Sale
description: After 29 years as a public-school nurse, I put $132,000 of my pension into a therapeutic shoe and custom orthotic clinic with my brother-in-law. He forged a dissolution, sold the assets for $650,000, and mailed me a $4,300 check. I found the original partnership agreement inside a hollow wooden shoe last, voided the sale, and now he grinds arch supports for me. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY DISSOLUTION. I FOUND THE SHOE.
pinned_comment: My brother-in-law forged a dissolution, sold my $650,000 clinic, and sent me a $4,300 check after I invested $132,000 of my nursing pension for a 50% stake. What would you have done the moment that hollow wooden shoe last rattled in your hands? Tell me your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: HE MAILED ME $4,300 AND THOUGHT I WOULD STAY QUIET
I FOUND THE CONTRACT IN A WOODEN SHOE
SO I VOIDED THE WHOLE SALE
